rationale: Builds on the current reverse-tail recurrent baseline instead of resetting. The edit adds a tiny learned scalar refresh on the recurrent anchor after each reverse tail replay, so late repeated blocks can gradually update the carry target instead of always pulling against a frozen decoder-output anchor. This is a compact recurrence-structure change in an unspent nearby category, keeps shapes compile-stable, costs almost no bytes, survives int8 export as a control tensor, and preserves the existing quant-aware endgame and exact final_int8_zlib_roundtrip_exact path.
title: Learned Tail Anchor Refresh
